The ticker is familiar.

RWA Sonar reads the legal documents and the Solana chain behind every tokenized stock and tells you what a holder actually owns, who holds the keys, how to get out, where it is used in DeFi, and what changed. Every answer links to the words or the transaction it rests on.

    Dated findings with sources

    Three things the evidence showed

    All dated changes →

    Control · read on chain, 20 Sep 2026

    xStocks' power to move or burn any holder's tokens sits behind a 2-of-3 multisig with no time lock.

    The permanent delegate on every xStocks mint is a Squads v4 vault: threshold 2 of 3, time lock 0, members unnamed. It has not been used on Solana: in all 1,844 transactions touching it from 10 Jun 2025 to 18 Sep 2026, no transfer or burn names it as authority.

    See who holds each power →

    Float · read on chain, 24 Sep 2026

    81.0% of priced xStocks supply sits in issuer wallets.

    Redeemed xStocks are not burned: the prospectus defines de-activation as a transfer back to the issuer. Across the 99 xStocks with a market price, $2.03B of $2.50B of supply was held by issuer-attributed wallets, including an inventory wallet the issuer itself excludes from its circulating figure. That leaves a public float of about $475M at most. Supply overstates what the public holds; our float is an upper bound.

    Read flows and float →

    Docs versus chain · 23 Sep 2026

    Loopscale's docs call a key a co-signer that "cannot initiate actions on its own". On chain it signs refinances alone.

    Found while decoding the SECZ lending market: that key is the protocol admin. The same docs describe a 3-of-5 upgrade multisig; the chain shows 4 of 7 voters and a 24-hour time lock.

    Open the market dossier →

    A closer look below the surface.

    Behind each token sit legal claims, custodians, issuer powers and fees. Our dolphin detectives represent the research that follows those connections and checks what changes.

    Follow the changes →How we check →

    Freshness

    What we watch, and how often

    Live collector health →
    • Hourly

      Token powers on chain

      Authorities, extensions, rebase multipliers and supply of every catalogued mint. A rotated key or a toggled extension becomes a dated event with its slot.

    • Hourly

      DEX trades

      Swaps on the busiest pools, decoded on our server and served by our API to the trades page.

    • Daily

      Every cited document

      Terms, prospectuses and docs pages are re-read and diffed, and each quote is re-checked word for word. A page a script cannot read falls back to the publisher's own API or a Wayback capture, and says so.

    • Daily

      Redemptions on chain

      Ondo burns, xStocks de-activations and Superstate conversions. On 23 Sep the scan saw 218 Ondo redemptions in the 17.9 hours it read. PreStocks and Tessera redemptions are not visible on chain; the page says why.

    • Daily

      Model change assessment

      A language model reads each changed document and says whether it matters to holders. Its answer is shown next to the diff as a model assessment. It does not decide what is published. Cost is recorded per item.

    • Daily

      Court and SEC filings

      CourtListener and SEC litigation feeds for every issuer's entities. A match is a lead for review; it never marks an answer "litigated" by itself.

    The public site rebuilds every 6 hours and the weekly summary is regenerated with it. A day we did not read is shown as missing, never as zero.

    Compared with market dashboards

    Market size tells you what exists.
    We show what you must trust.

    Market dashboards measure size and activity. RWA Sonar checks one product at a time: each report starts from an exact token address and follows it through the legal documents, the on-chain controls and the companies that run it.

    Broad market map

    RWA.xyz and DefiLlama

    Excellent for discovering assets and following AUM, flows, TVL, utilization and market rankings across chains. They answer: what is there, and how large or active is it?

    RWA.xyz ↗DefiLlama RWA ↗

    Diligence layer

    RWA Sonar

    Joins the exact address to holder rights, custody, issuer controls, live market state, confirmed protocol support and sourced discrepancies. It answers: what do I own, who can change the outcome, and what happens when something fails?

    Compare wrappers →

    The model we follow

    L2BEAT, extended to RWAs

    L2BEAT lists the trust assumptions and control paths of each rollup. We do the same for RWAs, and extend it past the code to contracts, custodians, transfer agents, redemption and insolvency.
